name: Perfect Addiction
original_name: パーフェクトアディクション
overview:
Akihito, a promiscuous, looks-obsessed college student, can't stand Sae, who has a beautiful face and a haughty attitude.

When he realizes that the girl he was eyeing at the group date is going for Sae, his frustration reaches its peak.

At that time, Akihito came across Sae arguing with a man in front of a hotel, and found out Sae is actually gay and a bottom. Sae reveals his troubles about not being able to feel comfortable, which is completely different from his usual life.

Akihito, who was stirred up, forcibly pushes down Sae, but Sae can't hold himself back anymore!?
